run_doc2query_cli: run doc_to_query.py to generate synthetic queries from documents using an LLM and BM25 hard negative mining
run_doc2query_with_gpt: run doc_to_query.py with gpt-4o model to generate three queries per document from the BRIGHT dataset
run_doc2query_with_hf: run doc_to_query.py with a HuggingFace Llama model to generate synthetic training data from documents
run_doc2query_with_filter: run doc_to_query.py with a length filter to generate queries from a subset of documents
run_doc2query_custom_prompt: run doc_to_query.py with a custom prompt_id and temperature to generate diverse synthetic queries
